cvpen_order.name: CVPen paid CV fulfillment

steps.gate: Collect only required contact, career, language, target-role, and delivery data; obtain privacy notice acceptance.
Reject or request clarification for missing or contradictory source facts.
Create unique order ID, exact EGP amount, currency, service SKU, and expiry.

Require provider-authenticated webhook/signature, matching order ID, amount, currency, successful settlement status, and unique transaction ID. SMS, screenshots, and customer claims are not sufficient alone.
Map client-provided evidence to target role; no invented experience or credentials.
Generate editable draft using only supplied and confirmed facts.
Check headings, parsing, keywords, formatting, and target-role relevance.
Block unsupported employers, dates, degrees, certifications, metrics, or achievements.
Independent checklist review; unresolved critical issue blocks delivery.
Export validated DOCX and PDF; scan for missing fonts, layout overflow, and malformed text.
Deliver to verified channel and log the exact artifact version and timestamp.
Collect feedback, track revisions, and record anonymized quality metrics.

non_negotiable_invariants: No CV work starts as paid work until payment is verified by a trusted provider event.
A successful payment must be idempotent; duplicate webhooks cannot create duplicate orders or deliveries.
Never store payment credentials, full card details, or unnecessary identity documents in agent memory.
No agent may fabricate a fact, claim, certification, metric, employer, or job outcome.
Critical QA findings block final delivery.
